subject: open terrain
defect: Broad level grass fields and sparse ordinary trees dominate Cloudreach views where layered elevated land and ledge detail should lead the route

subject: summit aviary
defect: The summit landmark reads as a small skeletal dome on grass beside a separate court instead of a layered stone sanctuary and its night silhouette stays dark

subject: architectural landmark read
defect: Several Cloudreach destinations present sparse plain or disconnected structures with weak landmark-specific detail

subject: exposed landform edges
defect: Floating island undersides form blunt dark slabs and several cliffs and grassy shelves have conspicuous straight extruded edges

subject: captain fight camera orientation
defect: During incoming warnings the camera repeatedly faces an empty part of the arena or crops the opponent and ally so the attack direction and exchange are difficult to read

subject: mounted terrace edge and cloud crossing
defect: The mounted deer and seated trainer retain their upright riding silhouette while travelling below the cliff and then continue apparently unsupported across the cloud floor

subject: grass and stone finish
defect: Tall grass intrudes through shrine paving while repeated grass and simple stone surfaces reduce close-range material distinction across sites

subject: bright Cloudreach route markers
defect: Saturated cyan posts rings and rails at the bridge and flight aerie compete with the built landmarks while the launch platform adds a bright flat yellow pointer

subject: named NPC post readability
defect: Several named Cloudreach NPCs look small or partly hidden behind the foreground trainer and nearby buildings, with little visible pose or costume detail to communicate their role

subject: dialogue foreground composition
defect: The foreground player or nearby posts hide much of the named speaker in several conversation frames

subject: terrace edge clouds
defect: Flat white polygonal cloud puffs cover the terrace cliff edge and read as loose foreground shapes against the continuous cloud floor

subject: dialogue speaker visibility
defect: Named speaker is absent from the visible world view while the portrait and dialogue line remain on screen

subject: catch chance feedback timing
defect: A stale failed-catch message remains along the bottom while the new aim state shows 100% CAPTURE CHANCE and a nearly empty target bar

subject: Cloudreach map region label
defect: The discovered Cloudreach Gate / Lower Cliffs label is cut after LOWER without a wrap or ellipsis

subject: floating dark strips
defect: Disconnected black rail-like strips cross grass and extend into open air above the Cloudreach void

subject: mushroom pickup variants
defect: Speed Mushroom and Wild Mushroom use the same pale yellow mushroom cluster silhouette at normal camera distance

subject: High Perches rim mushroom
defect: A yellow mushroom cluster appears suspended beyond the grassy rim with no ground beneath its stem
